title: Latent Hatred: A Benchmark for Understanding Implicit Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Curating a dataset of tweets from specific hate groups (e.g., White Nationalist, Ku Klux Klan, Racist Skinhead, Black Separatist) and evaluating SVM, BERT, and GPT baseline models on their ability to classify implicit hate categories and generate the implied target demographic.

Collecting and annotating tweets from Anti-Muslim and Neo-Nazi ideological hate groups to train and test classification and generative models on detecting implicit hate and explicitly identifying the targeted religious group.

Sourcing and filtering tweets from Anti-Immigrant hate accounts to evaluate the performance of natural language models in identifying implicit hate speech and extracting the target demographic and implied messaging.
Using tweets authored by Anti-LGBT hate groups as part of a benchmark corpus to test neural models on categorizing implicit hate and generating natural language explanations of the targeted groups.
